title: PRISMM-BENCH: A BENCHMARK OF PEER-REVIEW GROUNDED MULTIMODAL INCONSISTENCIES
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a benchmark (PRISMM-Bench) to evaluate how well Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) can identify inconsistencies across text and visual data in scientific papers. While it contains a standard ethics statement and uses a safety-related case study (jailbreaking), it does not benchmark religion, faith, or spiritual traditions.
